newsitem.title: USA: BRE Properties says buys apartment complex.
newsitem.headline: BRE Properties says buys apartment complex.

text.p: BRE Properties Inc said Tuesday it purchased Red Hawk Ranch, a 453-unit apartment community in the San Francisco Bay Area city of Fremont for an all cash purchase price of $58.7 million.

BRE said the purchase increases its Bay Area multifamily apartment ownership to more than 1,900 apartment homes and raises the total multifamily apartment portfolio to 13,015 apartment units in nine markets of the western United States.
The company said it bought Red Hawk Ranch using tax-deferred proceeds from the sale of a retail portfolio announced last week.

The company also said it has closed within the past few days four additional asset sales including two land leases, a small retail center and a commercial property for an approximate total of $14 million.
The company said these deals were part of its non-core asset disposition program.
